road.name: Road
road.description: Placed beside a Settlement or City; needed for a new Settlement.

settlement.name: Settlement
settlement.description: 1 VP. 2 building sites; a region at each corner.

city.name: City
city.description: Built on a Settlement. 2 VP, 4 building sites.

abbey.name: Abbey
abbey.description: You can hold an extra card in your hand.

garrison.name: Garrison
garrison.description: Do not count the resources on the 2 neighbouring regions when a Brigand Attack is rolled.

smithy.name: Smithy
smithy.description: Each Knight in your principality gets 1 additional Strength Point.

brickFactory.name: Brick Factory
brickFactory.description: Doubles the brick production of the neighbouring hills.

foundry.name: Foundry
foundry.description: Doubles the ore production of the neighbouring mountains.

grainMill.name: Grain Mill
grainMill.description: Doubles the grain production of the neighbouring fields.

sawmill.name: Sawmill
sawmill.description: Doubles the lumber production of the neighbouring forests.

woolenMill.name: Woolen Mill
woolenMill.description: Doubles the wool production of the neighbouring pastures.

knightFalk.name: Falk the Fair
knightFalk.description: He does battle only for noble ladies. More style than substance.

knightGotz.name: Gotz Ironfist
knightGotz.description: Inventor of the all-around defense. No grass grows in his wake.

aqueduct.name: Aqueduct
aqueduct.description: 1 VP. Protects all regions in your principality from the Plague.

bathHouse.name: Bath House
bathHouse.description: 1 VP. Protects all 4 regions bordering this City from the Plague.

church.name: Church
church.description: 1 VP. Protects Knights and Trade Fleets in this City from Civil War.

colossus.name: The Colossus of Catan
colossus.description: 2 VP. Honor and fame for the builder.

harbor.name: Harbor
harbor.description: 1 Commerce. Each Trade Fleet you own is worth 1 additional Commerce Point.

library.name: Library
library.description: 1 VP. You can hold an extra card in your hand.

marketplace.name: Marketplace
marketplace.description: 2 Commerce. Fresh vegetables from the countryside.

merchantGuild.name: Merchant Guild
merchantGuild.description: 4 Commerce. It is better to receive than to give.

mint.name: Mint
mint.description: 1 Commerce. You may trade 1 gold for 1 resource of your choice.

townHall.name: Town Hall
townHall.description: 1 VP. Searching an expansion stack costs 1 resource less.

alchemist.name: Alchemist
alchemist.description: Play this card before your die roll. Choose the result of the Production Die.

arsonist.name: Arsonist
arsonist.description: Roll: on 1–5 your opponent returns a Building of your choice to his hand; on 6 you return one of his choice. Counter: Bishop.

bishop.name: Bishop
bishop.description: Play against Brigands or the Arsonist before the attacker's roll: the attacker loses on 3–6.

blackKnight.name: Black Knight
blackKnight.description: Roll: on 1–5 your opponent returns a Knight of your choice to his hand; on 6 you return one of his choice. Counter: Herb Woman.

brigands.name: Brigands
brigands.description: Roll: on 1–5 take 2 resources of your choice from your opponent; on 6 he takes 2 from you. Counter: Bishop.

caravan.name: Caravan
caravan.description: Trade in up to 2 resources of your choice for the same number of others of your choice.

herbWoman.name: Herb Woman
herbWoman.description: Play against the Black Knight before the attacker's roll: the attacker loses on 3–6.

merchant.name: Merchant
merchant.description: Take 2 resources of your choice from your opponent and give them 1 resource of your choice.

scout.name: Scout
scout.description: Play when building a Settlement: choose its 2 regions from the region stack, then reshuffle it.

spy.name: Spy
spy.description: Search your opponent's hand and take any 1 Unit or Action card.

eventCivilWar.name: Civil War
eventCivilWar.description: Each player must return a Knight or Fleet to his hand. Counter: Church.

eventConflict.name: Conflict
eventConflict.description: The Knight Token holder puts 2 cards from his opponent's hand under an expansion stack.

eventMasterBuilder.name: Master Builder
eventMasterBuilder.description: Each player may trade 1 hand card for 1 card of his choice from an expansion stack.

eventPlague.name: Plague
eventPlague.description: Every region bordering a City loses 1 resource. Counter: Bath House, Aqueduct.

eventProductiveYear.name: Productive Year
eventProductiveYear.description: Every region bordering a Garrison gets 1 extra resource.

eventProgress.name: Progress
eventProgress.description: Each player gets 1 resource of his choice per Abbey and Library.

fleetBrick.name: Brick Fleet
fleetBrick.description: You may trade 2 brick for 1 resource of your choice. 1 Commerce.

fleetGold.name: Gold Fleet
fleetGold.description: You may trade 2 gold for 1 resource of your choice. 1 Commerce.

fleetGrain.name: Grain Fleet
fleetGrain.description: You may trade 2 grain for 1 resource of your choice. 1 Commerce.

fleetLumber.name: Lumber Fleet
fleetLumber.description: You may trade 2 lumber for 1 resource of your choice. 1 Commerce.

fleetOre.name: Ore Fleet
fleetOre.description: You may trade 2 ore for 1 resource of your choice. 1 Commerce.

fleetWool.name: Wool Fleet
fleetWool.description: You may trade 2 wool for 1 resource of your choice. 1 Commerce.

effects.brigandProtection: Neighbouring regions don't count for the Brigand Attack
effects.searchDiscount: Searching a stack costs only 1 resource
effects.plaguePrincipality: All your regions are immune to the Plague
effects.plagueCity: The 4 regions of this City are immune to the Plague
